# WiCare ApS

> WiCare is a private chef and catering business north of Copenhagen, Denmark (Hellerup, Gentofte, Lyngby-Taarbæk, Rudersdal, Hørsholm and Allerød). Our chef, Wiktoria R., has 13+ years of experience in professional kitchens, including Michelin-starred restaurants and as sous-chef at the Danish Parliament (Folketinget). She cooks at the client's home, office or a venue of their choice. Every menu is designed with the client – there are no fixed packages, and the price is always agreed before we start. WiCare also offers cleaning for homes and businesses, and garden & construction work, as additional services.

Contact: phone/WhatsApp +45 52 72 11 02 · hello@wicare.vip · https://wicare.vip · CVR 46213270. Booking is by phone or WhatsApp; we work evenings and weekends by arrangement. The website is in Danish (default) with an English version.

## Private chef & catering (main services)

- [Privat kok – private dinners at home](https://wicare.vip/privat-kok/): A private chef for an intimate dinner or a dinner party in your own home. Menu designed around your taste, the occasion and any allergies or dietary needs; wine pairing, service and cleanup by arrangement.
- [Firmacatering – corporate catering](https://wicare.vip/firmacatering/): Lunches for meetings, receptions, anniversaries and client dinners, cooked and served at the company or a venue.
- [Fester & selskaber – parties and celebrations](https://wicare.vip/selskaber/): Birthdays and anniversaries, confirmations, weddings, summer and garden parties.
- [Julefrokost – Christmas lunch](https://wicare.vip/julefrokost/): Company or family Christmas lunch with a private chef (November–December).

## Areas served

- [All towns we cover](https://wicare.vip/#areas): Hellerup, Skovshoved, Charlottenlund, Ordrup, Klampenborg, Gentofte, Jægersborg, Kongens Lyngby, Sorgenfri, Virum, Taarbæk, Holte, Søllerød, Nærum, Skodsborg, Vedbæk, Birkerød, Hørsholm, Rungsted and Allerød. Each town has its own page under https://wicare.vip/omraader/ (for example https://wicare.vip/omraader/hellerup/).
